about_the_game:
Dice Team

——Your strategy is your ultimate trump card!

When 3D strategy collides with probability metaphysics

Every dice roll is a heart - pounding moment!

Will it be a desperate comeback or a total defeat?

In this mysterious tower that has swallowed countless adventurers

Only the perfect combination of wits and luck

Can help you break through layers of deadly traps!

Unique Dice - Gambling Mechanism

  • Five basic dice faces, hundreds of equipment combinations, and dozens of relic effects.

Deep - Thinking Strategy

  • Every turn is a life - or - death decision. The "undo" button is like a magic eraser for regrets.

Mysterious Tower Random Events

  • Each floor holds unexpected crises and treasures.

Immersive Battle Scenes

  • Epic battles of wits unfold on the dark slate floors.

Build your destined squad:

A brute - force output team? A steady - defense team? Or a lucky - gambler team?

Every step is a life - and - death gamble.

Are you brave enough to take on the ultimate test of the mysterious tower?

short_description: This is a turn-based strategy adventure game. You need to form a crack 5-hero squad, collect mysterious props, build powerful hero abilities, defeat powerful monsters, and uncover the secrets of this world.
